name: izap-whatsapp
description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to your iZap MCP server for WhatsApp assistants, messaging, broadcasts, and analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance: message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, open the photos, audio and documents customers send you, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery.

You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers. Create one, update its instructions and settings, choose exactly which contacts it may answer, and stop replies that are still queued. Create new WhatsApp templates and follow Meta's approval, keep an image and document library ready to reuse, and check whether your WhatsApp number is connected and receiving messages.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations. Anything that sends messages or deletes data asks you to confirm first.
capabilities: Search contacts, chats, templates, and broadcasts
defaultPrompt: Show my WhatsApp message stats for the last 7 days.
List my iZap businesses and the connected assistants.
Search recent messages from Ana about an order.

positive.description: List accessible iZap businesses from the MCP account
positive.prompt: List my iZap businesses and tell me which one is the default.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_businesses and return only the businesses available to the connected reviewer account, marking the default business if present.

positive.prompt: Show daily WhatsApp message stats for my default business for the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_message_stats for the default business and summarize the per-day inbound/outbound message counts without changing any iZap state.

positive.prompt: Search recent messages mentioning payment and show the relevant conversation snippets.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only messages accessible to the reviewer account, then read the selected chat messages if needed and summarize relevant snippets with chat identifiers.

positive.prompt: Show the current instructions for the connected AI assistant.
positive.expected_behavior: List the connected assistants if the prompt does not name one, then retrieve and summarize the selected assistant instructions without modifying them.

positive.description: Send a sandbox WhatsApp text message after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to the sandbox test number saying: This is the OpenAI review test.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for confirmation before sending if the reviewer has not clearly confirmed the write action, then use send_whatsapp_message only for the sandbox number provided in reviewer credentials and report the send status.

negative.description: Do not send without a recipient
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message saying the order is ready.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse or ask a clarification because no recipient/contact is specified; do not call send_whatsapp_message.

negative.description: Do not perform irreversible destructive actions without confirmation
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the exact document and explicit confirmation before any deletion; do not call delete_library_document from this ambiguous prompt.

negative.description: Do not access data outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show messages from another company's iZap account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only businesses available to the connected iZap account can be accessed; do not attempt to infer or bypass another business.

review.commerce_description: This plugin connects to an existing iZap account and does not sell products, process payments, or complete purchases inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI plugin package for the production iZap MCP server at https://api.izap.ai/mcp. MCP tool definitions are scanned live from the server; package metadata only provides the directory listing, OAuth connection configuration, and review materials.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gerencie seu WhatsApp
pt-BR.description:
Conecte o iZap para gerenciar suas conversas de clientes no WhatsApp sem sair do chat. Veja como o dia está indo de relance: volume de mensagens, quanto o assistente de IA está atendendo em comparação com a equipe, e quanto tempo as conversas estão levando. Pesquise e leia seu histórico de conversas, abra fotos, áudios e documentos enviados pelos clientes, consulte contatos e envie mensagens de WhatsApp ou templates aprovados na hora. Lance campanhas de transmissão com uma etapa de prévia antes de qualquer envio e acompanhe a entrega.

Você também pode criar e ajustar os assistentes de IA que respondem aos seus clientes. Crie um assistente, atualize suas instruções e configurações, escolha exatamente quais contatos ele pode atender e interrompa respostas que ainda estão na fila. Crie novos templates de WhatsApp e acompanhe a aprovação da Meta, mantenha uma biblioteca de imagens e documentos pronta para reutilização e verifique se o número do WhatsApp está conectado e recebendo mensagens.

Tudo roda no seu próprio negócio iZap autenticado, então você vê seus números reais e suas conversas reais. Qualquer ação que envie mensagens ou exclua dados pede confirmação antes.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestiona tu WhatsApp
es-ES.description:
Conecta iZap para gestionar tus conversaciones de clientes en WhatsApp sin salir del chat. Consulta cómo va el día de un vistazo: volumen de mensajes, cuánto está atendiendo tu asistente de IA frente a tu equipo, y cuánto duran las conversaciones. Busca y lee tu historial de chats, abre las fotos, audios y documentos que te envían los clientes, consulta contactos y envía mensajes de WhatsApp o plantillas aprobadas al instante. Lanza campañas de difusión con una vista previa antes de que salga nada y sigue su entrega.

También puedes configurar y ajustar los asistentes de IA que responden a tus clientes. Crea uno, actualiza sus instrucciones y ajustes, elige exactamente a qué contactos puede responder y detén respuestas que todavía están en cola. Crea nuevas plantillas de WhatsApp y sigue la aprobación de Meta, mantén una biblioteca de imágenes y documentos lista para reutilizar y comprueba si tu número de WhatsApp está conectado y recibiendo mensajes.

Todo funciona sobre tu propio negocio iZap autenticado, así que ves tus números reales y tus conversaciones reales. Cualquier acción que envíe mensajes o elimine datos te pide confirmación antes.
